# Smart Search 0.3.4

Smart Search 0.3.4 replaces typed setup menus with a guided terminal interface and applies the same interaction model to bundled skill management.

## Improvements

- Adds arrow-key selection for Grok transport, skill scope, and installation method.
- Adds Space-toggle multi-selection for Agent targets, with detected Agents preselected.
- Uses Y/N confirmations and hidden API-key input.
- Confirms existing provider values one by one and keeps them by default.
- Treats environment-provided values as externally managed and never copies their secrets into `config.json`.
- Shows a masked configuration and skill-installation summary before making changes.
- Shares the guided selectors across `skills install`, `update`, `uninstall`, and `status`.
- Keeps deterministic CI behavior through `--non-interactive`, explicit scope/Agent options, and `--yes`.

## Safety and compatibility

- Esc/Ctrl-C exits with status 130 before writing configuration or skill files.
- Non-TTY sessions return an actionable parameter error instead of falling back to typed menus.
- Existing CLI flags, JSON output, config format, provider contracts, and npm launcher behavior remain compatible.

## Verification

- Python test suite: 215 tests.
- Real TTY verification covered arrow-key selection, hidden secret input, and cancellation without config writes.
- npm wrapper, packaged non-interactive setup, npx skill installation, and npm tarball validation passed.
- Packaged validation covers canonical skill installation and linked multi-Agent targets.

The interaction design was checked on 2026-07-27 against the official [`vercel-labs/skills`](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills) implementation, including its prompt and Agent-selection flows.

## Install or update

```bash
npm install -g @shirlytaylor73/smart-search@latest
smart-search --version
smart-search setup
```
